steps.label: End Goal
steps.title: Own a profitable content business with repeatable revenue and flexible work.
steps.meaning: The business has dependable demand, clear monetization, and can run with a simple weekly operating rhythm.
build: Track revenue, audience growth, retention, and weekly publishing consistency.
Document the repeatable content and sales system.
Keep reducing the work that depends only on personal motivation.

steps.label: Previous Step 1
steps.title: First repeatable revenue stream is working.
steps.meaning: A small but real offer, sponsorship, product, or service is producing repeatable income.
build: Choose one offer and sell it to a narrow audience.
Publish weekly content tied to the same customer problem.
Review what creates leads and double down for four weeks.

vehicleAttrs.name: Offer clarity
vehicleAttrs.meaning: The business has a clear offer for a specific buyer and problem.
build: Write the offer in one sentence.
Test it with five real prospects.

vehicleAttrs.name: Distribution system
vehicleAttrs.meaning: There is a repeatable way to reach the right audience.
build: Publish or outreach on a fixed weekly cadence.

driverAttrs.name: Execution consistency
driverAttrs.meaning: You can keep the core weekly actions moving even when motivation changes.
build: Protect two focused work blocks per week.

driverAttrs.name: Sales confidence
driverAttrs.meaning: You can discuss the offer, handle objections, and ask for the sale.
build: Write down common objections and responses.
